title: Selected clauses compute the next OR layer
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit whose first-layer gates are OR gates, and choose any finite set of first-layer gate indices. The CNF formula formed from the corresponding first-layer terms computes the same Boolean function as the next-layer gate on those selected outputs.
